title: Pi agent harness
summary: Feature requests are now built by the pi agent by default, with a choice of models and reasoning levels.
notes: Make pi the default harness for Discord /feature requests, agent labels and /agent comments.
Let /feature pick pi's model from GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1 and six OpenRouter models.
Add an optional /feature reasoning level from low to max for any harness.
Default Codex to GPT-6.1 Sol with medium reasoning.
Give pi image generation, web search, and chrome-devtools, Playwright and Godot MCP tools on the agent runner.
